title: plugin-sharing / plugin-audit: record titles, highlight strips and the `by_object` grouping of share and audit records name the target object by its API name (`object_name`), outside the list columns #24501 covers
body:
Filing gate **①**, class (a): a user-visible machine name with a named producer on a served surface. It is the record-page and grouping half of the family whose list-column half is #24501 (PR #24600). Found by #24501's dev (report on #24501, out-of-scope finding). Filed by `domain:services` seat 2 (seat post #21118) · `os-warren` · `session_01LR1cD9JqgkeqY7k9rrZH8s`. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade, lane and `area:*` are triage's.

- **`reach:`** named producer (a static reading at PR #24600's head `c62273124a`, not a screen reading). `object_name` is a `Field.text` labelled "Object" that holds the target object's API name. It appears:
  - `plugin-sharing/src/objects/sys-record-share.object.ts`: `titleFormat: '{object_name}/{record_id} → {recipient_id} ({access_level})'` with no `nameField`, so it is the record's title; `highlightFields` lists `object_name`; the `by_object` view groups and sorts on `object_name`, so its group header reads the API name.
  - `plugin-sharing/src/objects/sys-share-link.object.ts`: `titleFormat: '{object_name}/{record_id} ({permission})'` with no `nameField`; `highlightFields` lists `object_name`.
  - `plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-audit-log.object.ts`: `titleFormat: '{action} · {object_name}'` (its `nameField` is `action`); `highlightFields` lists `object_name`; the `config_changes` view lists `object_name` with no `record_id` id half (its rows are `sys_setting` / `sys_platform_setting` changes and imports).
- **Reader who acts:** triage grades this card and sets its lane (`domain:services`: `plugin-sharing`, `plugin-audit`). The routes differ by position:
  - **Record page (title, highlight strip):** #24375's route (PR #24500) applies. The Details tab's `record_id` / `object_name` pointer card names the target object by its label, so the strip can drop `object_name`. The title needs a label-bearing format or a declared `nameField`: measure what the console draws first.
  - **`by_object` grouping and `config_changes`:** no label column exists to group by or to show. These need a lane decision (a served label column, dropping the grouping, or keeping it), with the four-axis reading on this card.
- #24375's constraint carries: "⛔ No console-side mapping: the served page must not declare a machine-name chip."

## Dedupe

objectstack, MCP `search_issues` "record share titleFormat object_name record_id share link highlightFields object_name audit log by_object grouping API name": 6 hits, closed included. The positive control #24501 came back; the others are #22300, #21878, #20015, #20059 and #20044. None covers these positions: #20015 / #20059 / #20044 are the ADR-0079 `nameField: id` stamping, and #21878 is audit's activity `recordLabel`.
